newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary revises Feb trade gap down to $275 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary revises Feb trade gap down to $275 mln.

text.p: Hungary's Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism (MIT) revised the preliminary figure for the January-February trade deficit to $275 million from $431.4 million, MIT Deputy Secretary of State Lajos Berenyi told Reuters on Friday.

NOTE - MIT data are based on customs statistics. Berenyi said the ministry regularly revises its trade figures due to belated figures of lease work exports and duty free zones. Figures for January-March 1996 have also been revised. The January-March 1997 import figure was revised to $4,510 million from $4,509 million. Berenyi said the January-March 1997 preliminary deficit figure was likely to be reduced later by at least $150 million.
